netlists, file paths, seeds, stack traces, or secrets.

peak_fs.description: Peak |sample| as a fraction of full scale after gain.

url.description: Relative URL serving audio/wav for this session only.

AudioComparison.description:
A set of clips rendered with ONE shared voltage-to-playback gain.

Clips are never independently normalized. If headroom forced a reduction, the same
``gain_adjustment_db`` applies to every clip and ``note`` discloses it.

gain_adjustment_db.description: Shared reduction applied to all clips (0 = none).
gain_adjustment_db.title: Gain Adjustment Db

note.description: Plain-language disclosure of gain and processing.
note.title: Note

playback_gain_fs_per_v.description: Shared gain: full-scale units per volt.
playback_gain_fs_per_v.title: Playback Gain Fs Per V

AudioComparison.title: AudioComparison

message.description: Optional learner question (hint runs) or instruction (investigate runs).
message.title: Message

CaseCreateRequest.description:
No seed, fault, or value fields: clients cannot choose or learn the hidden state.
``template_id`` picks the circuit family (public); null draws it at random with the published
``policy.CASE_FAMILY_PRIOR``. Returns 409 if the session already has an open case.
CaseCreateRequest.title: CaseCreateRequest

client_request_id.description: Required idempotency key scoped to the case. Same key + same body returns the stored result without consuming budget; same key + different body → 409; a key still in flight → 409 (retryable).
client_request_id.title: Client Request Id

probe.description: Required for transient_capture; forbidden for sweeps.
probe.title: Probe

CaseOutcome.description:
Definitions:
- exact_identification: correct if a fault/no_fault conclusion names the true cause;
  abstained for insufficient_evidence; not_submitted if closed without a diagnosis.
- unsupported_certainty: a fault/no_fault conclusion whose EvidenceCheck was ambiguous or
  contradicted.
- functional_recovery: not_needed when the truth is no_fault (regardless of action);
  otherwise restored / not_restored from the measured verification, or not_attempted.
CaseOutcome.title: CaseOutcome

seed.description: Published only after closing, for reproducibility.
seed.title: Seed

CaseStatus.description:
ready → observing → diagnosis_submitted | unresolved → repair_verification → closed.
``failed`` = infrastructure failure after the permitted retries; it can only be closed.
The full transition table is in docs/contracts.md.
CaseStatus.title: CaseStatus

default_goal.description: The template's opening goal (e.g. keep the tone, remove the interference).

default_revision.description: A ready-to-simulate revision with the template's default values.

description.description: Trusted topology text built from the graph, e.g. 'C1 — capacitor — 100 nF — connected between Output and Ground'.
description.title: Description

label.description: Short designator shown on the schematic, e.g. 'R1'.

nodes.title: Nodes

value_si.description: Canonical SI value (ohms or farads). None for the source.

value.title: Value

ConsistencyCheck.title: ConsistencyCheck

margin_db.description: Positive = satisfied with this much room.
margin_db.title: Margin Db

DesignSuggestion.description:
A goal-to-design preview built from first-order RC equations: target cutoff, nearest
standard (E12) part for the varied component, and predicted tone gains. Nothing is
measured until the learner applies it as a revision and runs an experiment.

feasible.description: Whether any cutoff satisfies every constraint.
feasible.title: Feasible

tradeoff.description: When infeasible (or rounding to a standard part misses a limit): which constraint falls short and by how much, for the closest achievable design.
tradeoff.title: Tradeoff

DesignSuggestion.title: DesignSuggestion

revision_id.description: The revision whose template and values to start from.
revision_id.title: Revision Id

vary.description: Which component to choose; the other keeps its current value.
vary.title: Vary

candidate_hypothesis_ids.description: Only for insufficient_evidence: explanations that still fit.
candidate_hypothesis_ids.title: Candidate Hypothesis Ids

citations.description: At least one is required for fault and no_fault conclusions.
citations.title: Citations

hypothesis_id.description: Required when conclusion = fault; forbidden otherwise.
hypothesis_id.title: Hypothesis Id

suggested_instrument.description: Only for insufficient_evidence: what would help.

EditProposal.description:
A previewed edit. Predictions are analytical and labeled; nothing is measured until the
user applies the proposal (creating a revision) and runs an experiment.

template_id.description: Target template when the proposal switches circuit family (e.g. low-pass to high-pass); null keeps the base revision's template. A switch lists both R1 and C1.
template_id.title: Template Id

EditProposal.title: EditProposal

EvidenceCheck.description:
Trusted code's assessment of the submission against recorded evidence. Recorded and
displayed; it does not silently change the submission.
EvidenceCheck.title: EvidenceCheck

EvidenceCitation.description:
Validated server-side: the observation belongs to this case and succeeded, the quantity
exists for its kind, and frequency_hz (if given) matches a measured frequency (±0.1 %).
EvidenceCitation.title: EvidenceCitation

EvidenceRef.description: Points a numerical claim at the recorded result that measured it.

distinguishing_instruments.description: Instruments whose predictions differ among the remaining hypotheses. Null while status is ready/observing AND budget remains (it would steer the investigation); published once the budget is spent or the status is past observing.

statement.description: Deterministic summary, e.g. 'Two explanations fit…'. While distinguishing_instruments is withheld it must not name instruments.
statement.title: Statement

RepairProposalInput.description:
A repair replaces ONE component with a part of its intended nominal value (taken from
the frozen intended revision). Free values are not accepted, so a compensating change to the
wrong component cannot pass as a repair. May be replaced until verification.
RepairProposalInput.title: RepairProposalInput

RepairVerification.description:
Only the proposed component is changed in the hidden circuit; the result is compared
with the intended design. Functional recovery is reported separately from whether the
fault was correctly identified (that is only known at reveal).

audio.description: Expected vs Repaired output clips at one shared gain.

SourceSpec.description:
Ideal voltage source V1 between ``in`` (+) and ``gnd`` (−).

AC analyses drive it with ``ac_magnitude_v`` (1 V, 0°) so output voltage equals the
transfer function and source current equals input admittance × 1 V. Transient analyses
drive it with the sum of ``tones`` (sines starting at t = 0, zero phase).
SourceSpec.title: SourceSpec
